text:
Priya (Product): Quick update: Rolling out Private Retention Controls v1 to VPC/on-prem customers at 09:00 UTC today. Purpose: let customers set tenant-level retention windows for ephemeral artifacts (session traces, debug logs) and request audited purge bundles. This complements the Local Data Deletion API we shipped earlier.

Liam (Eng): Implementation notes: retention policy is enforced locally by the agent, policy sync via customer-control-plane webhook, and purge runs produce a signed bundle: {purge_id, deleted_paths[], sha256_manifest, signed_timestamp}. Example purge trigger: ```POST /agent/purge -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"tenant":"acme","policy_id":"retain-30d"}'``` Response: purge_id + status url.

Noah (SRE): Rollout plan: staggered canary across 10 customers 09:00-09:20 UTC, monitor delete-failure-rate and bundle-sign errors. I'll enable alerts if bundle-sign failure >0.5% over 5m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for private-retention-1 at 2026-04-02T09:00Z.

Priya (Product): Action items: Legal - confirm wording for retention controls in contracts; Support - update KB and escalation; Sales - prepare customer-facing FAQ.

Clara (Legal): Reviewing privacy wording. Need explicit opt-in wording for telemetry that is kept for <X days for operational reasons. Also confirm that the signed bundle metadata meets auditability requirements (we need signer key id included).

Ravi (Sales): Can we get a short TL;DR for customers? Prefer a 25-word line and a ~2 sentence explanation. We'll use it in outreach. Also want a list of canary customers so CSMs can reach out.

Liam (Eng): Draft TL;DR: "Set tenant-level retention windows for ephemeral artifacts on your Private/VPC deployment. Automatic purges generate a verifiable bundle for compliance checks." Full FAQ to #docs after GA.

Noah (SRE): Canary metrics at 09:15: 10 purge jobs run, 0 bundle-sign failures, median purge runtime 120ms, audit logs written. Proceeding to wider rollout 09:25.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Full rollout initiated for private-retention-1 at 2026-04-02T09:26Z.

Clara (Legal): Signer key id requirement confirmed. Legal OK with GA messaging once Support KB links are present.

Maya (Support): I'll add step-by-step troubleshooting: "if purge bundle missing, check agent key rotation and KMS access; if checksum mismatch, collect agent logs and escalate to SRE." Tagging #support-kb when live.

Priya (Product): Post-rollout follow-ups: (1) Sales outreach template (Ravi), (2) short ops checklist for on-call (Noah), (3) telemetry opt-in config docs (Clara). I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to gather GA copy.

Ravi (Sales): 👍 prepping customer email. Will request CSM list from ops.

Noah (SRE): Follow-ups: create alert dashboard panels for "purge bundle age" and "failed purge_sign". Will add runbook link: https://redir.company/runbooks/retention-purge-v1.

Priya (Product): Thanks team. If any customer-facing issues crop up, @Priya and tag #eng-oncall. We'll post the GA announcement draft in this channel after legal + support confirm KB links.
